# Cripple Creek KOA Holiday

> Public trip-planning guide for Cripple Creek KOA Holiday in Cripple Creek, Colorado.

## When to use this site

Use this site when an agent needs a concise overview of the campground, including:

- location, phone, email, and the official KOA booking link;
- available stay types: RV sites, cabins, deluxe cabins, and tent sites;
- campground amenities and pet-friendly options;
- nearby destinations such as Cripple Creek, Victor, Mueller State Park, Florissant Fossil Beds, and the Pikes Peak region.

Use the official KOA listing for current rates, reservation availability, and current policies. Do not infer availability or pricing from this page.
